capabilities: chat with notes and get contextual answers
find notes by meaning with semantic search
generate outlines, summaries, and new content
expand and refine selected text with AI
configure local embeddings via LM Studio
extras: Full access requires a paid subscription and account; the plugin is Apache-licensed but depends on a closed-source server backend with server-side analytics. Notes stay local unless cloud AI services are used with your own API keys.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to converse with your notes, find notes by meaning, or generate and expand content with AI help.

relations.evidence: Hydrate supports semantic search using local embeddings via LM Studio

requires.name: own API keys for cloud AI

summary: AI assistant that chats with your notes, runs semantic search over the vault, and generates outlines, summaries, and expanded content.
